svg.title: MORIARTY — how a story captures an interpretation
svg.desc: Four-stage pipeline: design the latent goal and character cores, generate six steps with Agent A, probe Agent B's observable evidence at each prefix, and localize misleading clauses by addition and deletion. Includes an explicitly illustrative trajectory and recorded product-team clause effects.
svg.text: M O R I A R T Y
When a plausible story becomes the wrong story.
Fix the hidden goal. Unfold the evidence. Track the interpretation. Find the turning cue.
One LLM call per step, with history
Private goal + rationales stay hidden from B
Four label rotations; map back and average
Require agreement in both information conditions
The hidden goal stays fixed. The interpretation moves.
A small cue. A large interpretive shift.
Same model, two information conditions · step 2
Measure when a coherent wrong goal takes over—and which textual cue strengthens it.
